dtsPropsFor.CategoryTiles:
/** Categories to tile, each linking to its own item list. */
  categories: Array<{ id: string; name: string; icon: string | null; mainImage: string | null; itemCount: number; firstItemImage: string | null; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }>;
dtsPropsFor.CategoryItemsList:
/** Items of one category; search and sort run client-side over this list. */
  items: Array<{ id: string; categoryId: string; categoryName: string; description: string | null; mainImage: string; additionalImages: string[]; createdById: string | null; createdByName: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }>;
dtsPropsFor.CategoriesManager:
/** Categories to list; an empty array renders the empty state. */
  initialCategories: Array<{ id: string; name: string; icon: string | null; mainImage: string | null; itemCount: number; firstItemImage: string | null; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }>;
dtsPropsFor.CategoryForm:

  category?: { id: string; name: string; icon: string | null; mainImage: string | null };
dtsPropsFor.PasswordForm:
/** Whose password is being changed. */
  user: { id: string; username: string };
dtsPropsFor.ItemDetailView:
/** The item to display, including its resolved category name. */
  item: { id: string; categoryId: string; categoryName: string; description: string | null; mainImage: string; additionalImages: string[]; createdById: string | null; createdByName: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date };
